stemMd: Choose the version with a logically placed modifier.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Walking through the orchard, the first blossoms attracted Lena.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Walking through the orchard, the branches were full of blossoms.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Walking through the orchard, there were blossoms everywhere.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Walking through the orchard, Lena noticed the first blossoms.

explanationMd: An introductory participial phrase should modify the subject immediately following it. Lena, unlike blossoms or branches, can walk through the orchard.

distractorRationale.a: The introductory modifier incorrectly makes blossoms the walkers.
distractorRationale.b: The subject branches cannot perform the introductory action.
distractorRationale.c: There is no named walker for the modifier to describe.
